values.title: Mental Demand
values.description: How mentally demanding was the task (e.g., thinking, deciding, remembering, looking, searching)?

values.title: Physical Demand
values.description: How physically demanding was the task (e.g., controlling, activating)?

values.title: Temporal Demand
values.description: How rushed or time-pressured did you feel during the task?

values.title: Effort
values.description: How much effort did you put into accomplish your level of performance?

values.title: Performance
values.description: How successful do you think you were in completing the task?

values.title: Furstration Level
values.description: How frustrated did you feel during the task?
